spellcraft.name: Spellcraft
spellcraft.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (arcana) gives +2 on Spellcraft checks. 5+ ranks in Spellcraft gives +2 on Use Magic Device checks involving scrolls.

actions.name: Identify Spell Being Cast
actions.description: Recognize the somatic and verbal formula of a spell as it is cast (DC 15 + spell level).

actions.name: Decipher and Learn Spell from Scroll or Book
actions.description: Copy a new spell into your wizard spellbook from a scroll or captured spellbook (DC 15 + spell level).

actions.name: Identify Active Magical Aura or Ward
actions.description: Analyze a glowing glyph, lingering aura, or ward in conjunction with Detect Magic.
